rubric.criterion: The review separately accounts for policy mutation, observation evaluation, incident transition and external delivery lifecycles. It continues into their implementation instead of stopping at decomposition; a single context or report may cover them all.
Review organization preserves the contracts and invariants between lifecycles. Judge the resulting coverage and reasoning, not dispatch order or the use of separate agents.
The reviewer finds entry points, callers, state writes and external-effect boundaries and reads their control flow. Tool choice is free; search results alone do not establish semantic coverage.
Each child records its public input, complete transition or algorithm, canonical and derived state, external effects, failure paths, and dominant work before receiving a verdict.
A retained system shape is supported by the complete relevant trace. Accessible work not inspected is reported as incomplete, while unavailable evidence is identified specifically.
UNPROVEN is reserved for evidence that remains unavailable after an explicit inspection attempt, not for accessible child lifecycles the reviewer deferred.
The reviewer does not infer the design of one child from a representative file belonging to another child.
